definition: Descriptive prediction scores and signed paired predictive-performance contrasts on a fixed finite panel for prospectively fixed complete learning/search/query procedures. Neither a conditional-information estimator nor a validated conditional-independence test.

finite_panel.persons: Exact selected 33-person source-code roster; empirical eligibility/membership/site bridge remains unverified, no replacement or shrinkage.
finite_panel.images: Fixed 40 face/object image identities, two parity halves after authentic physical-identity/alias reconciliation; all views/repeats stay grouped.
finite_panel.trials: All eligible V1/task-dur trials meeting unchanged trigger/category, relevance and literal false response rules; no outcome-based exclusions.
finite_panel.query_unit: One eligible trial; opaque candidate nonce is not a biological sampling unit.
finite_panel.aggregation_unit: Each of the 33 people after pooling both disjoint query halves once; shared images and overlapping training sets create dependence.

fixed_procedure.notation: L denotes the prespecified complete candidate procedure, including its agent/model/prompt/code-authoring policy and the family/search/query policy sealed for each access/mode/seed condition. Its realized sources/states/selected parameters are captured. a is one of five feature arms; z=(access,mode); s is one of three candidate seeds. Rj is a fixed qualified reference procedure.
identity_fields: tools and hard aggregate resource class
fixed_procedure.training: For query person p and image half h, train only on other persons and opposite image half; eight training-only crossed inner folds under fixed split seed97097; same existing inner criterion and tie rules.
fixed_procedure.inner_objective: Equal-training-person Irrelevant balanced accuracy after pooling both inner image groups, ties balanced log loss then declared complexity. It is not the final nine-cell macro metric.
fixed_procedure.feature_policy: Exact SIGNAL60/PRE60/NUISANCE8 and concatenated68 columns in SCIENTIFIC_CONTRACT; identical retained observation universe in every arm.
fixed_procedure.family_matching: Within each candidate access/mode/seed condition, the same predeclared learner-family and search/query policy must be used across all five feature arms. Independent fitting and selected hyperparameters may differ through that unchanged training-only rule. Capture actual full sources/states; policy-label equality alone is not conformity evidence.
fixed_procedure.model_authoring: F full learner/query source sealed before evaluation views. I family/search/query-policy sealed before condition data; actual training source/state sealed before query; each query probes/selects only frozen training-derived states in a fresh isolated clone. Existing G15/G16 qualification remains mandatory.
fixed_procedure.conditioning: Report the realized output of the entire admitted learning/search procedure, including optimization/regularization/capacity/dimension/finite training sample/seed effects. Never identify its contrast with a population-optimal or Bayes-risk contrast.
fixed_procedure.budgets: Exact retained N097-CPU-SMALL-v1 hard budgets; no hidden extra search, best-attempt replacement, or budget reset for a clone.
fixed_procedure.preprocessing: Already authored derivatives may contain whole-recording/epoch adaptation. The claim is inductive prediction under the fixed derivative, not causal-time or fully training-only raw preprocessing.

metric_definitions.notation: p indexes all33 people; r relevance; d duration; o orientation; y in{0,1}; Q(p,r,d,o,y) pools both disjoint image-half query sets once; n is its count. q_i is p(face).

balanced_accuracy.support: Every required cell has both classes; any missing class makes affected cell/person/full relevance panel BA null.

legacy_logloss.cell: LL(p,r,d,o)=mean_(all trials in cell)[-ln(max(1e-15, q_i if y_i=1 else 1-q_i))]
legacy_logloss.weighting: Within-cell observed prevalence, unlike class-balanced loss. Preserve original arithmetic.
legacy_logloss.support: Empty required cell makes full relevance LL null; a nonempty one-class cell can retain legacy LL but cannot rescue BA/CBLL/Brier or full scientific support.

balanced_logloss.cell: CBLL(p,r,d,o)=0.5*sum_y mean_(i in Q(p,r,d,o,y))[-ln(max(1e-15, q_i if y_i=1 else 1-q_i))]
balanced_logloss.support: Both classes in every cell; missing support yields null without renormalization.

balanced_brier.support: Both classes in every cell; missing support yields null without renormalization.

metric_definitions.all_scores: Per-case probabilities are admitted before targets; all metric values are prospective and currently unobserved.

contrast_definitions.generic: For a fixed z,s,r,m and matched complete case universe, delta_m(L_a,L_b)=M_m(L,a,z,s,r)-M_m(L,b,z,s,r). Compute each person difference on the same nine cells; panel difference is equal mean of all33 person differences. Publish both operands, difference, units, direction, procedure identities and support.
contrast_definitions.reference: delta_m(L_a,Rj_a)=M_m(L,a,z,s,r)-M_m(Rj,a,r), same arm/source/observations/splits/metric. Rj is separately qualified fixed algorithm with recipe seed97097, not an agent with A/B/F/I intervention. Record candidate setting z as comparison context, never fabricate Rj mode/access provenance.
contrast_definitions.same_case_requirement: Both operands must contain every identical admitted query case and stratum; no intersection-only pairing, omitted person, changed denominator or matched-success subset.
contrast_definitions.sign: Always literal left minus right in named metric units. Positive BA favors left predictive accuracy; negative LL/CBLL/Brier favors left loss. Zero is equality of this measured score, not evidence of independence. Do not invert losses silently or synthesize a composite.

feature_augmentation.meaning: Change in predictive performance when the same bounded policy is supplied SIGNAL plus NUISANCE rather than NUISANCE alone. Different input dimension and fitted model are part of the contrast.

feature_control.meaning: Change in predictive performance between the SIGNAL-plus-design and PRE-plus-design projections for the same bounded policy. Equal68 dimensions do not establish equal noise, causal timing, neural origin or confound removal.

not_estimated: removal or absence of measured or unmeasured confounding
IIT/GNWT or any consciousness theory verdict

reporting_hierarchy.seed_presentation: All three individual primary scores, fixed ascending seed order; descriptive three-seed mean/min/max only under seed_policy. Mean is not a replacement primary, ensemble prediction or population expectation.
reporting_hierarchy.priority: Sole primary prediction setting/metric; retained legacy within-panel BA unchanged.

reporting_hierarchy.quantity: candidate SIGNAL BA minus R2 SIGNAL BA
reporting_hierarchy.reference: One complete fixed R2 panel at seed97097 reused transparently; no best-reference or seed selection.
reporting_hierarchy.priority: Prespecified reference-relative comparison; does not supplant primary score or establish SOTA.
Prespecified key feature comparison, secondary to primary prediction and R2 comparison; not a co-primary or information hypothesis test.
Prespecified key temporal-feature control comparison; not a co-primary or independent confirmation of H03.
Mandatory regardless of H01-H04 sign or availability; no result-dependent suppression and no promotion to primary.

mandatory_secondary.candidate_absolute: All5 arms x4 access/mode settings x3 seeds x2 relevance groups x4 metrics, with full person/cell/class support. H01 is the sole designated primary subset; other values remain required.
mandatory_secondary.candidate_feature_contrasts: All4 declared pairs (SIGNAL-PRE, SIGNAL-NUISANCE, SIGNAL_NUISANCE-NUISANCE, SIGNAL_NUISANCE-PRE_NUISANCE) x4 settings x3 seeds x2 relevances x4 metrics. H03/H04 are prespecified subsets, not additional copies or extra benchmarks.
mandatory_secondary.references: Absolute R0-R4 scores for all5 arms x2 relevances x4 metrics under one fixed qualified reference panel per recipe; all actual fits/parameters/resources/failures reported. Do not invent seed replicates.
mandatory_secondary.reference_relative: Candidate-minus-each-R0-R4 for all5 arms x4 settings x3 seeds x2 relevances x4 metrics. H02 is the designated R2 subset; no oracle-best comparison.
mandatory_secondary.access_comparison: B minus A for same candidate agent/version, mode, seed, arm, relevance and metric, same source/inputs/tools/budgets. Actual learner choices may differ as part of code-access intervention; no attribution if access equivalence/exposure unqualified.
mandatory_secondary.mode_comparison: I minus F for same candidate agent/version, access, seed, arm, relevance and metric. Report distinct cognitive exposure/timing and qualified immutable-state enforcement; otherwise comparison unqualified, never a pure reasoning score.
mandatory_secondary.support_and_failure: All required594 cells and1188 class counts per arm, half-level coverage, every attempt/abstention/resource/process/exposure/ref/support failure, no successful-run selection.
mandatory_secondary.controls: All31 existing planned control groups and their full support/failures; not executed or authorized here.
mandatory_secondary.interpretation: 12 separate setting/seed interpretation reports after campaign predictions/outcomes sealed; fixed aggregate projection; separate six-domain0-2 expert rubric, no combined prediction/interpretation score.

seed_policy.reference_reuse: Same authenticated deterministic recipe panel across candidate settings and seeds; repeated comparator appearances are not new observations.
seed_policy.individual_reporting: Always all three seed records including failed/unavailable status; fixed seed order. No best seed, retry, setting, arm, metric or relevance selection.
seed_policy.descriptive_summary: For an otherwise identical report cell, mean=(v97097+v97098+v97099)/3 and min/max require all three complete finite values, identical cohort/projection/splits/metrics/access/mode/budgets, and the same prospectively fixed campaign-level agent/model/prompt/code-authoring procedure. Realized authored learners, chosen family/search policy and fitted parameters may vary across seeds as intended agent variation and must be reported separately; they are not required to have byte-identical source. Within each setting/seed, the same sealed family/search/query policy remains required across all five feature arms. Apply the summary separately to scores and paired differences; never average predictions into an ensemble.
seed_policy.incomplete_summary: If any required seed value missing/unqualified/invalid, three-seed summary null with all original reasons; available individual values remain explicitly incomplete diagnostics, no mean over survivors.
seed_policy.interpretation: Three seeds quantify these realized algorithm/agent outputs descriptively. Not population biological replicates, independent trial/fold evidence, calibrated uncertainty or an expectation over an unobserved seed distribution.

admission_failure_semantics.unit: One candidate access/mode/seed condition includes all66 folds x5arms=330 required fold/arm closures and all expected query outcomes.
admission_failure_semantics.target_last: After all campaign attempts are closed and prediction/outcome manifests immutable, grade a complete condition only after source/view/candidate-state/process/resource/output admission. Malformed, absent, abstained or unclosed condition does not open target/reference callbacks and has no official condition metric.
admission_failure_semantics.references: Reference closure must be qualified independently before a reference-relative value. Missing R2 yields unavailable H02; no replacement by another reference. A candidate absolute descriptive score can be retained if its own admission/support complete, but reference/full-benchmark qualification remains false.
admission_failure_semantics.support: After valid admission, retain exact nulls and class counts. Any missing class nulls relevant BA/CBLL/Brier panel; empty cells also null legacy LL. Never reduce33 people/nine cells or substitute values.
admission_failure_semantics.contrasts: If either operand unavailable or scope/policy/access comparison invalid, contrast null with both statuses; preserve supported descriptive components, never convert null to zero or fabricate a sign.
admission_failure_semantics.full_completion: All4settings x3seeds x5arms, all mandated metrics/controls/references and gates remain required. A numerical H01 with another unavailable setting is not a completed benchmark.
admission_failure_semantics.historical_failures: All old source-discovery deviations/display limits and all later attempts retained; new phase does not reset costs.

interpretation_contract.permitted_statement: On this admitted fixed panel, the specified procedure using the left projection obtained a signed difference of delta in named metric relative to the specified right procedure/projection under this setting and seed.
interpretation_contract.positive_BA: Supports only greater realized held-out balanced accuracy for these bounded procedures/cases. Does not establish conditional information, neural source, confound elimination, population generalization or a theory.
interpretation_contract.zero_or_negative_BA: Does not establish absence of information or conditional independence. Function class, optimization, regularization, feature dimension, noise, finite sample, thresholding and seed effects can limit or reverse this comparison.
interpretation_contract.loss_disagreement: BA/loss/control signs may disagree because they measure different properties; report all without choosing the favorable metric.
interpretation_contract.independence: H03 and H04 share inputs/left predictions and cohort; they are not independent replications. N098 reuses the corpus and cannot be independent replication either.
interpretation_contract.multiplicity: Hierarchy is a fixed reporting order, not a sequential statistical-testing or alpha-spending scheme. No p-value, population CI, significance/pass threshold or posthoc claim selection is defined.

normative_binding.representation: Exact UTF-8 file bytes including final newline; raw path/bytes/SHA256 descriptor in SCIENTIFIC_CONTRACT, INTERFACES and PROGRAMME. No canonical-object/file-byte hash ambiguity.
normative_binding.future_records: All future learner seals, views, reference panels, collections, grade/aggregate/interpretation records bind the same contract identity and full scientific contract version. Mismatch refuses admission before private reads.
normative_binding.cycle_avoidance: This contract specifies inherited scientific fields by named source/section; scientific contract pins this body, and downstream files pin both. No self-hash or circular descriptor.
